invariants.description: exact RC relaxation: V = V_in + (V_rest_approx - V_in) exp(-t (1 + channel_ratio) 1e6/(R C)) (MOhm, pF, s)
I = (V_in - V)/R and I_channels = channel_ratio I

bc_sweep.rationale: soma potential -90 to +40 mV; resting potential -80 to -50 mV; channel_ratio 0-2; c_m, d_ax, L_ax and R_i by 0.5-2 (C = c_m pi d_ax L_ax and R = 4 R_i L_ax/(pi d_ax^2) span the RC time 0.25-4 of its value, as the previous R and C sweeps did).

baseline.reason: phenomenological cable stand-in; no directly comparable measurement.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: d_ax, L_ax and R_i (R and C) would need conduction-delay data; none chosen.
